steps.text: Select a documented Interactions-capable model with the global `--model` option and rerun the modern Google GenAI profile.
Confirm that the selected model is intended for the Interactions API; `generateContent` metadata alone does not prove Interactions support.

workarounds: Use the strict `google-genai-generate-content-compat-2026-09.json` profile when the gateway exposes only legacy generateContent.
caveats: The pinned Official Google Gen AI Go SDK has no public Interactions methods, so this requirement is native-only at this version.

steps.text: Expose the `/interactions` route for an eligible model, or select the legacy profile when this surface is intentionally unavailable.

caveats: An optional or profile-informational Interactions probe is not evidence that legacy generateContent is incompatible.

steps.text: Return a Google RPC-style `error` object with a client-error HTTP status for unknown models.
Reject every malformed JSON request at the gateway boundary with a stable 4xx Google error envelope.
